summary: For modules using third-party web APIs, emulate the API's documented responses so tests check only spec-defined parameters. The rds_instance example builds a sequence of fake instance states as a MagicMock side_effect.
questions: How do I fake a sequence of API responses in a unit test?
How can I make sure my module only uses documented API fields?
How do I mock boto3 describe calls returning different states?

answer_card.title: Emulate an API spec in unit tests
